en: Colorized historic street view showing a wide cobblestone street lined with multi‑story European townhouses and shops. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk and stand along the sidewalks; horse‑drawn carts are visible on the right. In the background and on the right side rise tall church spires. The lower margin has printed captions indicating the city and the street name, and a vertical text line on the left identifies the printer in Leipzig.
